The main takeaway from our work is that
MICU1 is a critical regulator of muscle function.
MICU1 is a key regulator of mitochondrial Ca2+-dependent processes in skeletal muscle, and that its loss causes a mitochondrial Ca2+ overload that impairs muscle function.
MICU1 is a critical gatekeeper of the mitochondrial Ca2+-uniporter, and its loss-of-protein mutations cause a muscle disease by dysregulating Ca2+-dependent mitochondrial function.
